title: Arena settings
description: Versioned settings document for an arena instance (ADR-24), stored in arenas.settings. Unlike elo_settings (a date-keyed series) these settings are date-independent: changing them affects every match of the arena. League parameters live here; the shared formula constants (K, D, starting_elo, win_reward) stay in elo_settings. leagues lists the leagues that exist in the arena in promotion order; an empty array means no leagues (league is NULL on settlements, display rating equals true Elo). v1 carries no entity references, so no x-entity-id marking is needed yet.

starting_rating.description: Initial display rating for players with no prior settlement in this arena.

goal_gap.description: Player stays in newbie while elo - rating > goal_gap.

matches_6m.description: Matches within the last 6 months required to reach/stay in elite.

matches_2m.description: Matches within the last 2 months required to reach/stay in elite.
